name: Puzzle Tales: Arcane Voyager
detailed_description:
《Puzzle Tales》 - Where Elimination Meets Roguelike Adventure

Eliminate gems, unleash secret arts, and crush your foes in a grand adventure across the Ether World!

【Smooth Elimination・Strategy Upgrade】

Eliminate gems to charge your secret arts, unleash powerful spells and effects, and turn the tide of battle in an instant.

Expand your strategy from the battlefield to the chessboard, choose from a wide range of skills to pave your path to victory, and combine roguelike elements with multiple heroes for a fresh strategic experience in every battle!

【Build Diverse・Infinite Possibilities】

Take your strategy to the next level with the introduction of new "Arcane Artifacts." Skills, relics, and artifacts - this is the "trinity" of 《Puzzle Tales》!

Even in the face of powerful enemies, the chessboard and pieces are forced to join the "Great Game," making the battle environment ever-changing and the difference between victory and defeat a matter of mere moments!

- From the Solo Developer to Future Adventurers -

This is a game crafted for both "strategy enthusiasts" and "leisure explorers," organically combining the thrill of puzzle games with the strategy of roguelike games to bring you a fantasy adventure.

Join the official community (Discord/Steam Community/QQ group) now, your support and suggestions will shape the future of the game!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit) or later version
  • Processor: INTEL. AMD 4 cores CPU @ 3Ghz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX-460 (4 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A380 (6 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit) or later version
  • Processor: INTEL. AMD 6 cores CPU @ 4Ghz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (8 GB) / Intel® Arc™ A580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
